info.title: Maskinporten Management REST API
info.description:
Manages Kartverket's Maskinporten scopes through Digdir's API: lists, creates and deletes the scopes, lists,
gives and removes organisations' access to them, and shows the changes to that access.

A call only reaches this API after the platform has checked that the calling app may make it. When a list
holds scopes, it only shows the ones the calling app has access to. Answers use Digdir's field names, but only
hold the fields described here: a field Digdir adds later is left out. When Digdir answers with an error, this
API returns that answer unchanged: its status, body and content type.

get.description: Returns 200 OK if the server is up. Not part of the stable API.

post.description:
Asks Digdir to create the scope in the body, which Kartverket then owns. The body is in Digdir's format and is
sent on unchanged. It may only hold the fields listed here, each once and spelled exactly so, so that the scope
cannot be read in two ways.

When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

value.description#en: Read access to the demo API

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

value.name: kartverk:tilgangsstyring/demo.read
value.description#en: Read access to the demo API

400.description: The URL has a query, or the body is not a JSON object in UTF-8 with `Content-Type: application/json`, or it has a field that is not listed here, or the same field twice, or `prefix` or `subscope` is missing or not text. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

delete.description: Asks Digdir to delete `scope`. Digdir keeps the scope with `active` set to `false`, so it no longer shows up in `GET /api/scopes`. When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The scope, for example `kartverk:matrikkel.read`. It must be the only query parameter, sent once.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

400.description: The query is not exactly one `scope`, or `scope` is blank, contains whitespace or is not URL-encoded correctly. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

get.summary: List Kartverket's scopes that the calling app has access to
get.description:
Asks Digdir for Kartverket's active scopes, and returns the ones the calling app has access to: the scopes in
its `exact` list, and the ones that start with one of its prefixes. This API reads which app is calling from
the `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` header, which Istio usually sets.

When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Client-Cert
parameters.description: Says which app is calling. Istio usually sets it on every call, so the app does not.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

200.description: The scopes the calling app has access to. The list is empty if it has access to none.

400.description: The `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` header is missing, so this API cannot tell which app is calling. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, from the service that says which scopes the calling app has access to, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to the filtering service failed
The call to Cloud KMS failed

get.summary: List the organisations that have access to a scope
get.description: Asks Digdir which organisations Kartverket has given access to `scope`. When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The scope, for example `kartverk:matrikkel.read`. It must be the only query parameter, sent once.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

200.description: The organisations given access to the scope. Check `state`: only `APPROVED` means access.

400.description: The query is not exactly one `scope`, or `scope` is blank, contains whitespace or is not URL-encoded correctly. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

get.summary: List the scopes an organisation has access to
get.description:
Asks Digdir which of Kartverket's scopes `orgnr` has access to, and returns the ones the calling app has
access to: the scopes in its `exact` list, and the ones that start with one of its prefixes. This API reads
which app is calling from the `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` header, which Istio usually sets.

When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: orgnr
parameters.description: The consumer's organisation number: 9 digits, for example `311718371`. It must be the only query parameter, sent once.

parameters.name: X-Forwarded-Client-Cert
parameters.description: Says which app is calling. Istio usually sets it on every call, so the app does not.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

200.description: The organisation's access to the scopes the calling app has access to. Check `state`: only `APPROVED` means access. The list is empty if there is none.

400.description: The query is not exactly one `orgnr`, or `orgnr` is not 9 digits, or the `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` header is missing. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

value.error: Query parameter orgnr must be an organisation number of 9 digits

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, from the service that says which scopes the calling app has access to, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to the filtering service failed
The call to Cloud KMS failed

get.summary: List the changes to who has access to a scope
get.description:
Asks Digdir for the changes to the access to `scope`, such as an organisation being given access or losing it.
Digdir answers a page at a time. Without `page` and `size`, it gives its first page, in a size it picks.

When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Which page to get, counting from 0.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The most changes a page holds.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

400.description: The query has a parameter other than `scope`, `page` and `size`, or one of them twice, or `scope` is missing, blank or not URL-encoded correctly, or `page` is below 0, or `size` is below 1. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

value.error: Query parameter page must be a whole number of 0 or more

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

put.summary: Give an organisation access to a scope
put.description: Asks Digdir to give `consumerOrgno` access to `scope`. When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: consumerOrgno
parameters.description: The consumer's organisation number: 9 digits, for example `311718371`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The scope, for example `kartverk:matrikkel.read`. It must be the only query parameter, sent once.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

400.description: `consumerOrgno` is not 9 digits, or the query is not exactly one `scope`, or `scope` is blank, contains whitespace or is not URL-encoded correctly. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

value.error: Path parameter consumerOrgno must be an organisation number of 9 digits

502.description: This API could not get an answer from Digdir, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

delete.summary: Remove an organisation's access to a scope
delete.description: Asks Digdir to remove the access `consumerOrgno` has to `scope`. Digdir keeps the access as inactive, so it no longer shows up in this API's lists. When Digdir answers with an error, that answer is returned unchanged.

parameters.name: consumerOrgno
parameters.description: The consumer's organisation number: 9 digits, for example `311718371`.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: The scope, for example `kartverk:matrikkel.read`. It must be the only query parameter, sent once.

default.description: Any other status is Digdir's own answer, passed on unchanged in Digdir's error format. The exception is a `500` with `code` `INTERNAL_ERROR`, which is an unexpected error in this API.

400.description: `consumerOrgno` is not 9 digits, or the query is not exactly one `scope`, or `scope` is blank, contains whitespace or is not URL-encoded correctly. Digdir can also answer `400`, in its own error format.

value.error: Path parameter consumerOrgno must be an organisation number of 9 digits

value.error: The call to Cloud KMS failed

name.description: The whole scope: the prefix, a colon and the subscope.

prefix.description: Digdir's prefix for the owner, `kartverk` for Kartverket: only the part before the colon.

subscope.description: The part after the colon, which the owner chose. It cannot be changed.

description.description: A short description in Norwegian Bokmål.

long_description.description: A longer description in Norwegian Bokmål. Left out, or empty, if the owner has not written one.

description#en.description: `description` in English. Left out if the owner has not written one.

description#nn.description: `description` in Norwegian Nynorsk. Left out if the owner has not written one.

description#se.description: `description` in Northern Sami. Left out if the owner has not written one.

long_description#en.description: `long_description` in English. Left out if the owner has not written one.

long_description#nn.description: `long_description` in Norwegian Nynorsk. Left out if the owner has not written one.

long_description#se.description: `long_description` in Northern Sami. Left out if the owner has not written one.

active.description: Always `true` in `GET /api/scopes`, which lists only active scopes, and `false` once the scope is deleted.

last_updated.description: When the scope was last changed.

allowed_integration_types.description: The kinds of client that can use the scope. A Maskinporten client needs `maskinporten`, or an empty list, which allows every kind. `unknown` is a kind Digdir has added that this API does not know yet.

owner_orgno.description: The organisation that owns the scope: Kartverket.

token_type.description:
The kind of access token issued for the scope.

- `SELF_CONTAINED`: a JWT that the API can verify itself. Maskinporten only issues these.
- `OPAQUE`: a token that the API has to look up with Digdir.
- `UNKNOWN`: a kind Digdir has added that this API does not know yet.

visibility.description:
Who can see the scope.

- `PUBLIC`: anyone, in Digdir's list of all scopes.
- `PRIVATE`: only the owner and the organisations given access.
- `INTERNAL`: Digdir's own use.
- `UNKNOWN`: a value Digdir has added that this API does not know yet.

requires_user_consent.description: Only for logins with ID-porten, not for Maskinporten: a person must consent before a client gets a token.

requires_user_authentication.description: Only for logins with ID-porten, not for Maskinporten: a person must log in again, even with an active session.

requires_pseudonymous_tokens.description: Only for logins with ID-porten, not for Maskinporten: tokens leave out the person's national identity number.

delegation_source.description: Where an organisation with access can delegate it to a supplier, such as `https://www.altinn.no/`. Left out when the scope cannot be delegated.

at_max_age.description: The most seconds an access token for the scope can live. `0` means Digdir's default.

authorization_max_lifetime.description: The most seconds an authorization for the scope can live. `0` means Digdir's default.

accessible_for_all.description: If `true`, every organisation can get tokens for the scope without being given access.

enforced_aud_for_access_token.description: Digdir does not document this field.

protected.description: Digdir does not document this field.

supports_european_businesses.description: Digdir does not document this field. Its name matches Digdir's feature that lets European businesses get tokens with an eIDAS seal, without being given access.

error.description: A short summary for people to read. The wording may change, so check `code` in your code.

code.description:
What went wrong. These values do not change, so your code can rely on them.

- `INVALID_REQUEST` (400): the request was refused before it reached Digdir. `error` says why.
- `UPSTREAM_ERROR` (502): this API could not get an answer from Digdir, from the service that says which
  scopes the calling app has access to, or from Cloud KMS, which signs this API's requests for
  Maskinporten tokens. Your request did not cause it.
- `INTERNAL_ERROR` (500): an unexpected error in this API.

owner_organization_name.description: The name of the organisation that owns the scope. Left out when Digdir has no name for it.

consumer_orgno.description: The organisation that was given access.

consumer_organization_name.description: The name of the organisation that was given access. Left out when Digdir has no name for it.

state.description: Where the access stands. Only `APPROVED` means the organisation has access, and giving access through this API sets it at once. Digdir does not document when it uses `REQUESTED` and `DENIED`. `UNKNOWN` is a state Digdir has added that this API does not know yet.

last_updated.description: When the access was last changed.

message.description: Digdir's short summary of the change. Left out when Digdir sends none.

actor_name.description: Who made the change, as Digdir records it. Changes made through this API are made with this API's Maskinporten client, not as the calling app. Left out when Digdir sends none.

channel.description: Where the change was made, as Digdir records it. Digdir does not document the values. Left out when Digdir sends none.

diff.description: What changed, as JSON in a string. Digdir does not document its format. Left out when Digdir sends none.
